title: Context
text: Over eight weeks, 40 reps in two regions used AI agents for call preparation, next-best-action and call notes. They made 14% more calls, converted 5% better on suggested visits, and generated 2,900 call notes without a compliance incident. The Board is asked to approve the scale-up on 6 November.

title: Objectives
text:
Roll the agents out to all field reps in Germany and Italy within 16 weeks.
Reach at least 70% daily use by month 4, the gate for wave 2.
Hand over a run model that {client.name} operates without external support.

title: Scope
text: In scope: about 900 reps in Germany and Italy, the three pilot agents, CRM integration, medical-legal guardrails, training and adoption tracking. Out of scope: new agent use cases, markets beyond wave 1, and changes to incentive schemes.

title: Approach
text:
Weeks 1-4: production readiness, data remediation and guardrail sign-off.
Weeks 5-12: rollout in four cohorts with floor-walkers and weekly adoption reviews.
Weeks 13-16: stabilisation, run-model handover and the wave-2 gate assessment.

title: Team
text: The pilot team continues, led by the engagement manager with partner oversight. The client provides a product owner, a data platform lead and a compliance reviewer for the full 16 weeks.

title: Fees

title: Terms
text: This proposal is valid for 60 days and is subject to the framework agreement between {client.name} and Cantab Pi. Fees are invoiced monthly in arrears.
